newsitem.title: USA: Platinum to buy Georgia record company.
newsitem.headline: Platinum to buy Georgia record company.

text.p: Platinum Entertainment Inc said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the assets and assume certain liabilities of Intersound Inc for about $24 million in cash and $5 million of convertible debentures.

Intersound, headquartered in Roswell, Georgia, is a large independent record company. Its music divisions focus on most major music categories including gospel, adult contemporary, country, urban, dance, classical and themed productions.

Products are distributed through Intersound's proprietary distribution system, which allows Intersound to maintain control over the marketing and promotion of its products, selling and fulfilling its orders on a direct basis.

For the year ended April 30, 1996, Intersound recorded earnings, before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, of $3.2 million on gross revenues of $33 million. On a proforma basis, revenues from the combined companies would have been about $58 million for the year ended May 31, 1996.

The acquisition requires satisfactory completion of due diligence and the financing by Platinum of the cash portion of the purchase price. Platinum said it intends to get the financing through bank loans or a private placement.
The acquisition is expected to close before 1996 year end.

Intersound "is a profitable record company with an extensive catalog and the type of company we have targeted for acquisition," said Steve Devick, Platinum president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Platinum produces, licenses, acquires, markets and distributes recorded music for a variety of music formats.
